{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Harpox''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] serving the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Harpox'' was introduced in the [[2008]] reference title ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. The [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] misspelt the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Harpax]]'' "''Harpox''." The accompanying ''[[TIE Fighter Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' made the same error.
